title: Multi-scale Metabolic Modeling and Simulation
summary: Biological systems are governed by coupled interactions between intracellular metabolism and bioreactor operation that span multiple time scales. Constraint-based metabolic models are widely used to describe intracellular metabolism, but repeatedly solving the optimization problem at each time step in dynamic models introduces numerical challenges related to infeasibility and computational efficiency. This work presents a multi-scale modeling framework that integrates genome-scale, constraint-based metabolic models with dynamic bioreactor simulations. Intracellular metabolism is described…
